common_state_probability_layer.purpose: Fixed shared persistence and ordered future-state probability layer. Redevelopment changes conditional production only.

continuous.prior1_coverage: 1 if genuine previous-season row exists else 0
continuous.opportunity_coverage: 1 only for governed weak/established source role with games/opportunity coverage

persistence_features.C_QB_only: For QB prime/aging only: prior_age_state_resid_z from previous completed season, plus explicit coverage; unsupported/missing -> 0 with coverage 0.

ordered_positive_state_features.common: Same common source features, coarse age rather than A2 exact-age terms.
ordered_positive_state_features.C_QB_only: Same QB prior_age_state_resid_z memory feature and coverage.
ordered_positive_state_features.D_state_percentile: Within source_season x position x source_state percentile = (average_rank(source_points)-0.5)/cell_n. Add centered 2*(pct-0.5) position-specific term; for premium/elite add max(0,(pct-0.8)/0.2) and max(0,(0.2-pct)/0.2).

common_state_probability_layer.monotonicity: At prediction, cumulative ordered probabilities are clipped to [0,1] and each successive threshold is min(previous_threshold,current_prediction). State masses are consecutive differences.
common_state_probability_layer.current_C_materialization: For a 2026 board, QB C memory is the 2025 age-band x state residual computed point-in-time from completed seasons strictly before 2025, using the frozen Phase-2 age-state residual definition. This new redevelopment does not target the lost sentinel scalar.

historical_fit_rule.Y2: For evaluation source t: train pooled h1/h2 rows with source_season<t and source_season+horizon<=t-1. For final 2026 fit: pooled h1/h2 rows with source_season<=2023 and target season<=2025.
historical_fit_rule.Y3: For evaluation source t: train h3 rows with source_season<t and source_season+3<=t-1. For final 2026 fit: h3 rows with source_season<=2022 and target season<=2025.

source_coordinate.source_percentile: Within source_season x position over eligible source players, average-rank percentile (rank-0.5)/n.
source_coordinate.prior1_points: Fantasy points from exact previous completed season for same player/position; otherwise uncovered.
source_coordinate.target_active: A target player-season row exists and realized target_state is positive; missing target row is out/non-persistent.
source_coordinate.deep_collapse_stress: target_points <= 0.25 * source_points, including non-persistent zero-point outcomes. Reporting only; never a route input.

production_preprocessing.target_population: Only target-active rows are used to fit D0/D1 conditional-production models.
production_preprocessing.continuous_scaling: Training-only mean and population SD (ddof=0). If SD<1e-12 use 1.0.
production_preprocessing.covered_history_scaling: Prior-history continuous features are centered/scaled on covered training rows only. Uncovered transformed value=0 with explicit coverage flag.
production_preprocessing.categorical_encoding: DictVectorizer(sort=True), one-hot keys encoded as numeric 1 values.
production_preprocessing.deterministic_row_order: Sort by source_season, player_id, position, horizon before vectorization/fitting.
production_preprocessing.bayesianridge_matrix: DictVectorizer(sort=True) output is converted to dense float64 with .toarray() immediately before BayesianRidge fit and prediction. This is representation-only; feature names/order/values are unchanged.
production_preprocessing.prior1_nonnegative_rule: Both scaler fitting and row transformation use log1p(max(prior1_points,0)). Negative fantasy-point totals are clamped to zero before log transform.

D0.name: Reproducible magnitude baseline
D0.partial_pooling: Single shared horizon model plus ridge-regularized position deviations for every continuous feature. No player-specific coefficients.

D1.name: State-conditional richer model
D1.estimator: Same explicit BayesianRidge settings as D0, fit separately by horizon.

prior2_consistency.coverage: 1 only when both t-1 and t-2 point-in-time age-band x state residuals exist for same player.
prior2_consistency.transform: Training-only covered-row mean/SD, ddof=0; transformed values 0 when uncovered.
features: position deviations for mean_z and gap_z

D1.partial_pooling: One shared horizon model across positions and all positive future states. State, position-state, state-magnitude, and position-deviation terms are regularized jointly; no separate tiny-cell models.
D1.output: Predict a nonnegative conditional point mean for each positive future state, then expected_points=sum(shared_state_probability[state]*conditional_points[state]); out-state production=0.

D2_routing.universal_rule: D1 becomes the preferred universal treatment for a horizon only if paired mean absolute-error gain D0-D1 is >0 in each early, mid, and validation block. Otherwise D0 is the universal default for that horizon.
D2_routing.cell_support_rule: A route cell is eligible only if it has >=20 identical-observation evaluation rows in each of early, mid, and validation and >=4 distinct source seasons overall.
D2_routing.cell_assignment_rule: Eligible position or position x career-stage cell routes to D1 only if D0-D1 paired mean absolute-error gain is >0 in every chronological block for that horizon. Otherwise that cell uses D0.
D2_routing.position_route_rule: Construct using the cell assignment rule. It may replace the universal treatment only if its aggregate D0/route paired mean absolute-error gain is nonnegative in every chronological block for that horizon and strictly positive in at least one block.
D2_routing.career_route_rule: Test only after position routing. It may replace position-only routing only if its aggregate paired mean absolute-error gain versus position routing is nonnegative in every chronological block for that horizon and strictly positive in at least one block. If effectively identical (all absolute block gains <0.05 points), prefer position-only.
D2_routing.sparse_rule: Weak, mixed, or unsupported cells use D0.

post_freeze_non_selection_replication.note: These years have been inspected previously and are descriptive replication only; they cannot change the selected route.

metrics: top10 and top5 source producers by position-season percentile
prime-established = career established and governed age_band=prime
persistence Brier/logloss and six-state Brier/logloss for shared state layer

uncertainty.method: Deterministic two-way multiplicative cluster bootstrap on paired row-level absolute-error differences with independent source-season and player exponential(1) weights; normalize by weighted row sum.
uncertainty.use: Descriptive 95% percentile interval; routing selection remains governed by predeclared chronological sign/support rules, not by CI shopping.

serialization.float_encoding: JSON decimal strings generated from Python float repr; arrays converted to JSON numeric lists.
serialization.hashing: SHA-256 over exact UTF-8 bytes of each JSON/CSV/code artifact; package manifest records hashes.

stop_conditions: If historical source/target reconstruction fails parity with governed rows beyond declared tolerance, stop Outcome C.
If no bounded candidate/routing earns support, Outcome B and stop; do not open another family.
If final fitted package fails reload/replay tolerance, Outcome C and stop before current players.
After current-player inspection, any material systematic credibility defect yields Outcome B without tuning.
